summary.zh: 把零散改动拆成清晰可审的提交
summary.en: Turn a pile of changes into clean, reviewable commits.

description.zh: 把混在一起的改动拆成各自独立的提交，配上说明清楚的提交信息，并在推送前拦截误入暂存区的密钥和 .env 文件。适合一次改动涉及多个主题，或提交历史杂乱需要整理时使用。
description.en: Splits mixed changes into separate commits with clear messages and blocks staged secrets or .env files before they are pushed. Use it when one session touched several topics or the history needs tidying.
